text_block_list.text:
The challenge at the award ceremony
attracted a
lot of attention, driving
flocks of fans to the
Hanshin Daishoten.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Нарита Брайан, however, is the same as
ever. She
pays no mind to the crowd,
instead bringing her
competitiveness up
to a boil.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
